annotations.title: How this workspace is being used

description: How this workspace is being used over a window (default 30 days): recall volume and the zero-result rate (the share of recalls that came back empty - the product-health canary), the caller mix (mcp/cli/web), reads, publishes, new versions and review/curation counts. Aggregate counts only - no item or person is named. Ask it to check in on your own workspace: "how many recalls this week, how many empty?"

days.description: days is the window to report over (default 30, clamped to 1..365).

space.description:
space optionally selects which of your spaces to act in (an id or name
 from list_spaces). Omit it when you belong to a single space.

name: get_usage

approvals.description: approvals / rejections are review decisions recorded.

comments.description: comments is the number of comments left.

days.description: days is the window actually reported over.

newVersions.description: new_versions is the number of artifact versions pushed.

publishes.description: publishes is the number of collections published.

reads.description: reads is the number of work reads (collections/artifacts/memories).

recalls.description: recalls is the number of recalls in the window.

recallsByCaller.description: recalls_by_caller splits recalls by caller kind (mcp / cli / web).

zeroResultRate.description: zero_result_rate is that as a percentage (0 when there were no recalls).

zeroResultRecalls.description: zero_result_recalls is how many returned nothing - the product-health canary.
